items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: another New Orleans man we had was Walls, the great bass player.

ctx.x: Like Roy Palmer said he inspired him.

He was a great trombonist, and he was, did all the trombone work for the, for the Handis Syndicate, and we had another one in the Syndicate. His name was Higgins, the banjo. He played banjo and sang, and then we, another New Orleans man we had was Walls, the great bass player.
